root_cause: The existing preflight selected projected Brain learning by explicit fingerprint and lane but did not use task intent when those labels were absent.
prevention: Preserve all mandatory prevention and exact requested learning fingerprints in every preflight.
Infer task-relevant skill targets from bounded natural language, return recent matching Brain prevention with digest, count and transparent truncation.
Treat new AI models, external tools and innovation as evaluated candidates, not automatically approved production technology.
Reuse one canonical Brain index, shared context, System Map and append-only ledger; never start a parallel learning scheduler.
terminal_rule: Protected latest SHA Required+CodeQL, reviewed merge, exact production/source readback, preflight receipt with digest and provenance. No fake paid outcomes.
